actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is above 30% of initial endowment, so baseline 80% contribution applies. Average contribution in the last round is below 30%, triggering conditional cooperation (+30% of wallet). Combined target exceeds wallet, so I contribute the full 1.1. Round 10 requires a norm broadcast. No affordable punishments are possible.
